en: Colorized historical postcard showing a line of cavalry lancers in blue uniforms with silver helmets and lances, dismounted beside their horses in a grassy field near a country road or ditch. In the background are scattered trees, flat farmland and a distant tower. Printed German text runs along the top of the card, identifying the location as Oschatz and the depicted unit as the Royal Saxon 1st Uhlan Regiment No. 17.
